_comment: Rulings the editor has given on rows in review/<slug>/translation_review.csv.
A cleared key is not raised again. The key is pad|page|kind|german, exactly
as check_translations.py builds it, so a ruling survives a re-run of the
sheet but NOT a change to the German on that page - which is deliberate: if
the transcription changes, the reading was never settled against this text.

notes.oe1bu9454-269a|1|rare-pair|Anweisung: Editor confirmed against the manuscript, 2026-09-11: the page reads Anweisung. Scan Oe_1_Bu_9454_0490_a2-L269a_01.jpg. "eine sichere Anweisung" on 100,000 Rthl is an order to pay; Abweisung, a refusal, cannot take sichere. The model was right not to flag it as ambiguous, and the English - "a secure instruction to pay" - stands.
